about.title: Drag Race Pokédex — because the multiverse got too big
about.lead: You see a queen, you know her face… and then boom 💥: UK? Canada? All Stars? Which season again?
about.why: I built this app for that exact moment. Just a little fan corner to find Drag Race queens and participants when your memory ghosts you. A Pokédex, but for legends in heels. 👠✨
about.what: Browse, search, remember… and take a quiz to see if you’re really up to date! 💅📚
about.feedbackLead: Tell us what’s broken or what you’d love next — fill in the short form and you’re done.
about.feedbackSoon: The feedback form is coming soon.
about.disclaimer: Fan-made project, not affiliated with RuPaul’s Drag Race, World of Wonder, VH1, MTV, or any official entity. Provided as-is, with no guarantee of completeness.

scoring.title: 🧠 Score
scoring.totalPoints: Each quiz is worth 100 points max (10 questions × 10 Cash pts).
scoring.confidenceIntro: Before answering, pick your confidence level with a difficulty mode. The riskier the mode, the more points you can earn.

howToWin.title: 👑 How to win

steps.scorePoints: Score as many points as you can out of 100

howToWin.goodLuck: Good luck… and don’t flop it. 💄

play.cashSearchHint: Type to filter, then pick an answer from the list.
play.quitConfirm: Leave this quiz? Your progress will be lost.

duo.label: ✌️ Duo — 2 points
duo.description: Two possible answers. One is right, one is wrong. A 50/50 — the safest way to bank a few points.

square.label: 💅 Square — 5 points
square.description: Four possible answers. Only one is correct. A classic multiple-choice: safer, but not the most lucrative.

cash.label: 👑 Cash — 10 points
cash.description: No multiple-choice shown: search the list and select the right answer. High risk, high reward.
